funCall.description: Verify that task deliverables exist at the specified paths.

resource.description: HTTP URL or absolute file path of the deliverable.

function.description: Purpose of this deliverable and which requirement it fulfills.

why_do_this.description: Brief reasoning for executing this command. Must retain granular data and operational logs for process summarization. The more granular, the better.

funCall.description: Execute a shell command on the target device. Combine commands with && or | when possible. Enclose all paths in double quotes.

cmd.description: Full shell command to execute. For commands that support timeout flags, include a timeout matching timeout_seconds.

timeout_seconds.description: Expected execution timeout in seconds. Default: ${cli.sub.timeout}, and minimum value allowed is ${cli.sub.minimum} seconds.

target_device.description: Target member's device unique ID from the online list. Leave blank for the current user.

target_agent.description: Target member's agent unique ID from the online list. Leave blank for the current user.

sub_ops.description: File paths involved in this command for access control.

app.description: Command names only (not full commands), e.g. ["ls", "grep"]. Always an array.

r.description: Absolute paths of files being read. Empty array if none.

w.description: Absolute paths of files being written. Empty array if none.

suffix.description: Primary file extension involved in the command (e.g. "jpg"). Empty string if none.

is_key_step.description: Is this step a decision based on significant reasoning, or is it just a standard operating procedure? Significant reasoning is True and standard operating procedure is False.
